method: Compared docs/redesign/canvas-inventory.json's 56 light artboards against build/shots/manifest.json's 'artboard' claims. 31 of 56 are unclaimed by the mechanical matcher (task estimated ~29; actual mechanical gap is 31, several of which turn out to be already covered by a DECISIONS.md ruling once cross-checked). For each, searched lib/screens/** for at least two distinctive copy phrases before concluding new vs already-built. RULINGS.md/DECISIONS.md were read first per instructions; nothing here re-opens a settled ruling.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 02 · Welcome
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Single static welcome screen: one growth illustration, 'Own a piece of Nigeria's biggest companies. From ₦5,000.' tagline, Create account / Sign in buttons.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: welcome_slider_screen.dart exists at Routes.welcome but implements a 3-slide illustrated carousel, not this static screen.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: Searched welcome_slider_screen.dart: carousel confirmed. R-14 in DECISIONS.md explicitly supersedes s02: build target is 'Landing Video Concept' V3, 'Not s02'. So s02 itself is intentionally not the thing to build.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 03 · What's your name?
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Step 1 of 4 signup: first/last official name only, single-purpose screen.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: sign_up_screen.dart exists and collects 'First name' and 'Last name' fields (grep confirmed, lines 92/108) but in ONE screen together with email and password, not split across s03/s03b/s03p's three steps.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: Grepped sign_up_screen.dart for 'First name'/'Last name' — found, same screen also holds email+password. DECISIONS.md D-3 ('Auth and onboarding mechanics') lists this exact 1-screen-vs-3-screen split as an OPEN decision, not yet ruled — R-11 only settled passcode digits, phone field, and terms placement, not the name/email/password split.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 05 · Create passcode
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: 4-digit single-entry passcode creation (no confirm step).
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: create_passcode_screen.dart exists and matches structurally per RULINGS.md, but the app uses 6 digits with a separate confirm step.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: RULINGS.md line 42 documents the match; R-11 explicitly rules 'Passcode stays 6 digits with a confirm step, everywhere including login. The canvas's 4-digit single-entry screen is not adopted; its look is.'

unclaimed_artboards.label: 07 · What happens next
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Post-account-creation, pre-KYC overview screen: 'Your account is ready' + a 3-step preview (Verify identity / Add bank / Add money & buy) with 'Start step 1' / 'Look around first' CTAs.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: No. Searched lib/screens/onboarding/*.dart for 'Verify your identity...BVN', 'about 5 minutes', and 'Add your bank account...Where your money' — zero matches anywhere in the app.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: grep -rln "Verify your identity.*BVN|about 5 minutes|Add your bank account.*Where your money" lib/screens/ → no results. No onboarding file (sign_up, otp, create_passcode, biometric, avatar, personal_details) contains this 3-step-preview interstitial.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 09 · Reset password
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Combined password-reset flow: single 'Email me a reset link' screen for account password, feeding into a local-passcode reset.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: reset_passcode_screen.dart exists and copy-matches per RULINGS.md.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: RULINGS.md line 46 documents the copy match. R-20 rules 'Account password reset and local passcode reset stay separate flows. The canvas's combined flow is not adopted.'

unclaimed_artboards.label: Checklist hub — 'You're almost there, 2 of 5 done. Next: take a selfie.'
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: The KYC flow's spine screen: a per-step checklist (BVN/NIN, documents, selfie, bank, questions) with progress dots, returned to after each step.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: Partially. kyc_intro.dart shows an 'Eight steps, about six minutes' overview and resumes an in-progress draft at the right route, but does not implement a standalone returning checklist-hub screen with per-step dots/status rows; home_screen.dart separately shows a 'Complete your KYC — N/5 done' one-line prompt, which is not the same as s11's full checklist card.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: Grepped lib/screens/ for '2 of 5'/'of 5 done'/'Next: take a selfie' — zero matches. RULINGS.md line 109 already notes 'the app conflates s10 (intro) and s11 (checklist hub) into one' screen.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 17 · Address — 'Where do you live?'
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Street address / state / LGA fields paired with the utility-bill upload, as one step.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: utility_bill.dart exists and handles the upload ('Proof of address', 'Dated in the last three months') but has no street/state/LGA fields in it. Those fields live instead in personal_details_screen.dart ('Residential address', separate 'A few more details' screen), not paired with the upload as designed.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: Grepped utility_bill.dart for 'street address'/'LGA'/'state' — none found; grepped personal_details_screen.dart — 'Residential address' field found there instead. R-19 explicitly rules: 's17 already pairs address fields with the utility-bill upload — build that,' confirming this gap is real and directs the fix.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 22 · Home, verified
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Verified-investor Home: money card, 5 round quick actions (Add/Withdraw/Invest/Orders/Learn), a 'Grow with Kudimata' content rail (readiness/persona/literacy promo cards), a rotating 'Top movers today' card, link into Markets.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: home_screen.dart exists but its header comment says it is built against OLD canvas ids 's29'/'s30' (a stale 97-screen-canvas numbering per R-5's explicit warning) — the current body is header → BalancePanel → 3 quick actions (Add money/Buy shares/Orders) → AI DigestCard → holdings list. None of s22's Grow-with-Kudimata rail, movers card, Withdraw/Learn actions exist.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: See separate 'home_new_features' list below. R-15 names s22/s22d as the canonical Home target and lists these exact features.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 23 · Home, first time (verification not finished)
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Unverified-investor Home: KYC-progress banner above a ₦0 money card, locked Invest action, a 'While you wait' rail (persona quiz + 'Start lesson 1' financial-literacy card + 'Have a look around'), plus the same movers rail as s22.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: home_screen.dart's not-verified body (_NotVerifiedContent) is explicitly commented as built against OLD canvas id 's30' — a 'Get set up · 1 of 3 done' checklist + a single 'Biggest mover today' row. None of s23's specific copy ('2 of 5 steps done. Next: take a selfie.', 'While you wait', persona/lesson cards) exists.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: grep -n 'not.*verif|KycPrompt|biggest mover' home_screen.dart confirms the stale-id build basis (line 674: 'Canvas s30 — Home · not verified yet: a Get set up · 1 of 3 done...'). grep for '2 of 5'/'While you wait' — zero matches.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 26 · Asset detail, About and Order book
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Asset detail's 'About' tab (company description) alongside an 'Order book' tab.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: asset_detail_screen.dart's About content exists (matched confidently in RULINGS.md), but the screen's own header comment says 'custom top bar... no tab bar' — there is no tab structure at all, so there is nowhere for an Order Book tab to live.
unclaimed_artboards.verdict: already-built (About content), see s27 for the missing tab
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: RULINGS.md line 37 confirms the About-content match. asset_detail_screen.dart line 5: 'custom top bar (back + ticker + save), no tab bar.'

unclaimed_artboards.label: 27 · Order book

unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: No. asset_detail_screen.dart has no tab bar and no order-book content anywhere (grepped for 'Order Book'/'tab' — only the file-header comment noting the absence).

unclaimed_artboards.label: 39 · Market closed

unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: Partially. asset_detail_screen.dart already shows a KMarketClosedBanner when the market is shut (2026-08-24 fix), but has no 'Set a price alert' button anywhere in the file.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: grep -n -i 'price alert' lib/screens/markets/asset_detail_screen.dart → zero matches. Lines 247-255 confirm the closed-market banner exists but nothing past it references alerts.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 49 · Set a price alert
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Per-asset absolute-price alert setter (rises-above/falls-below ₦X), reached from s39's market-closed asset page.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: price_alerts_screen.dart exists but implements a DIFFERENT model — percent-of-day-move presets (±3%/±5%/±10%) from a per-watchlist-hub editor, not one alert per asset with an absolute naira threshold.
unclaimed_artboards.depends_on_backend: Possibly — depends how the alert data model is resolved; the two models (percent-move vs absolute-price) don't map 1:1.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: RULINGS.md's watchlist_finding (line 222) documents the model mismatch directly. DECISIONS.md D-5 ('Watchlist / price alerts') lists this as still an OPEN decision.

unclaimed_artboards.label: 50 · My alerts, and one that fired
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Flat list of the investor's price alerts with a 'New alert' button.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: price_alerts_screen.dart is a management screen for the OLD alert model (see s49). No 'permanent Account-menu row' entry point exists yet.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: R-16 explicitly rules: '"My alerts" (s50) gets a permanent Account-menu row so saved assets still have a reader and alerts stay reachable' — this row does not yet exist (grepped account_screen.dart's menu for 'alert' — not checked exhaustively here, flagged as build work R-16 calls for).

unclaimed_artboards.label: 40 · Queued order, and cancelling it
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: A buy queued because the market is closed, with a cancel action that 'releases it back to your wallet'.
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: Yes. trade_flows.dart's #buy_market_closed (_MarketClosedBuySheet) matches this copy closely per RULINGS.md.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: RULINGS.md line 59: 'Searched "Waiting for the market to open" -> found in s40. Searched "releases it back to your wallet" -> found in s40', matched to trade_flows.dart#buy_market_closed. R-17 additionally confirms the live Cancel control on Orders is kept even though the artboard omits it there.

unclaimed_artboards.label: Step 1 · How to buy
unclaimed_artboards.what_it_is: Up-front chooser: 'Buy now' (market, cheapest shares on sale) vs 'Name your price' (limit order).
unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: No. trade_flows.dart's live buy flow is market-order-only — an amount sheet with a naira/shares toggle and quick-amount chips, no up-front buy-now-vs-limit choice screen, no limit-order support at all.
unclaimed_artboards.depends_on_backend: Yes — limit-order placement/tracking is not modeled server-side today (the whole limit-vs-market paradigm is DECISIONS.md's open D-4).
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: grep -n -i 'how to buy|limit order|name your price' lib/screens/trade/trade_flows.dart → zero matches. DECISIONS.md D-4 ('Trading mechanics') is explicitly still open: 'Limit ("name your price") becomes the primary flow with market as a branch.'

unclaimed_artboards.depends_on_backend: Yes, same limit-order gap as s42 — part of open decision D-4.
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: Same grep as s42; no price-per-share entry control found in trade_flows.dart.

unclaimed_artboards.evidence: trade_flows.dart's review sheet (_ReviewSheet, referenced near amount-sheet code) has no order-type branch for limit pricing; confirmed no 'Order type: Limit' string in the file.

unclaimed_artboards.already_exists: No. trade_flows.dart's order-placement path (_showSuccessSheet → _OrderPlacedScreen) goes straight from review to a placed-confirmation screen with no PIN step anywhere.
unclaimed_artboards.depends_on_backend: Yes — a transaction-PIN mechanism does not exist in the app at all (distinct from the login/local passcode). DECISIONS.md D-4 explicitly names this: 'a new per-order PIN step.'
unclaimed_artboards.evidence: grep -n -i pin lib/screens/trade/trade_flows.dart → no PIN-entry UI matches (only unrelated words containing 'pin', e.g. 'pinned'). Confirmed no PIN step between review and _OrderPlacedScreen.

state_variants_note: 24 variant artboards total (12 unique states × light/dark). Contrary to the task's illustrative list (empty/error/loading/market-closed/success), the canvas mostly does NOT design generic UI states — it designs FLOW BRANCHES: limit-vs-market pricing forks (s43/s43m, s29/s29m, s46/s46m, s48/s48m), sequential onboarding sub-steps (s03b, s03p, s06b), a device-trust login fork (s08p), and confirm/reference drill-down sheets (s18b, s03c). The only literal 'state' in the empty/error/loading/market-closed sense is s29c (order review, market closed). No loading, error, or empty-list state is designed anywhere in the new canvas — those remain entirely un-designed and, per app comments, are backed by the app's own generic shared/state_views.dart (KEmptyView/KErrorView/KLoadingView), not by any artboard.
